issues.what: the crater wall is a blurry, airbrushed orange gradient with no rock texture, meeting a flat uniform dark blue-black lake with no reflections, ripples, or wet shoreline
issues.fix: replace the smooth rim with detailed rocky slopes and talus, and give the lake realistic water reflections, subtle surface texture, and a natural shore transition

issues.where: mountain ranges across the entire island
issues.what: the terrain reads as a procedural Voronoi/erosion heightmap made of uniform clay-like ridges and white valley lines with a single material everywhere and no real geological variation
issues.fix: break up the repetitive procedural ridge network with varied rock strata, soil, scree, and fine surface micro-detail

issues.what: every coastline is ringed by a uniform artificial cyan glow and the lakes and ocean are flat dark blue fills with no surface texture, depth variation, foam, or sky reflection
issues.fix: replace the uniform coastal halo with natural bathymetry and irregular surf or wet edges, and add realistic water shading, glint, and reflections

issues.where: cloud bands on the left and volcanic plume at upper center
issues.what: clouds and plume look like flat streaked noise layers pasted over the map with no 3D volume, no atmospheric haze, and no shadows cast onto the ocean or land below
issues.fix: render volumetric clouds and plume with directional lighting, cast soft shadows onto the underlying sea and terrain, and add subtle atmospheric scattering

issues.where: all three terrain crops (top-left, bottom-left, and bottom-right panels)
issues.what: strong heightmap quantization produces stair-stepped contour banding and vertical pixelated striations across every slope
issues.fix: use a higher-bit-depth, higher-resolution heightfield with proper filtering and micro-displacement to eliminate contour stepping and grid striations

issues.where: cloud deck in the top-left and bottom-right crops
issues.what: cloud edges break into hard-edged, flat gray thresholded noise cutouts rather than soft wispy vapor
issues.fix: use multi-octave volumetric density falloff with soft wispy edges instead of hard alpha thresholding

issues.where: coastlines and inland lake edges in both crops
issues.what: the land-water boundary shows a jagged, pixelated dotted seam along the shore, and the eastern parallel ridges look soft and stretched
issues.fix: increase coastline mask resolution with smooth anti-aliased transitions, natural shoreline detail, and sharper terrain displacement on the eastern ridges

issues.where: orange glowing spots on the upper-right landmass (also visible in set-A-08.png bottom-left crop)
issues.what: soft circular orange dots sit on the dark terrain without following topography or illuminating nearby ridges and haze
issues.fix: tie volcanic glow to actual fissures or vents in the terrain and have the emission cast realistic warm light onto adjacent rock and smoke

issues.where: open ocean in the top-left and bottom-right crops (also in set-A-06.png right crop)
issues.what: tiny repeating rows of identical dotted flecks sit on the flat dark water, reading as tiled or aliased procedural noise artifacts
issues.fix: remove the repeating stippled noise artifact and replace it with non-repeating, physically based ocean surface detail

issues.where: crater lake in the left crop and slopes in the right crop
issues.what: white vapor wisps over the lake read as flat blurry streaks with no lighting or shadow, while the terrain crop shows stepped contour banding and soft low-res rock
issues.fix: give the surface vapor volumetric lighting and soft shadows on the water, and add high-frequency rock detail to the close-up slopes
